ideas.title: Local Repo Secret Scanner
ideas.description: Scans your local git repos for hardcoded API keys, tokens and secrets across all files and git history. 28M secrets leaked on GitHub in 2025, 64% still active years later. Can't manually check hundreds of files.
ideas.source: GitGuardian State of Secrets Sprawl 2026 / HackerNews

ideas.title: HN Pain Point Scraper
ideas.description: Scrapes HackerNews Ask HN posts, finds pain points, saves top 10 to JSON

ideas.title: Workflow Time Audit
ideas.description: Track your daily tasks for a week, auto-identify which ones are repetitive and how much time they waste. Outputs a ranked report of what to automate first.

ideas.title: Auto Knowledge Base Builder
ideas.description: Feed it a folder of Slack exports or email threads — it extracts repeated Q&As and builds a searchable markdown knowledge base automatically.

ideas.title: Screenshot Automation Script
ideas.description: Auto-capture screenshots of any list of URLs on a schedule. Save to folder with timestamps. Useful for SEO reports, QA, competitor monitoring.

ideas.title: Gmail Receipt Organizer
ideas.description: Scan Gmail for receipts/invoices, extract amounts + vendors, export CSV for tax time

ideas.title: Meeting Notes Formatter
ideas.description: Paste raw meeting notes, Claude formats into action items + decisions + owners

ideas.title: Freelancer Testimonial Collector
ideas.description: After a project ends, auto-send a testimonial request email, collect the response, format it nicely, save to a portfolio JSON file.

ideas.title: GitHub Stars Tracker
ideas.description: Tracks trending AI/automation repos on GitHub daily
